Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands split along gently undulating curves at about 50% of the way down her figure from the top and about 70% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first dividing curve: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 2 is the band between dividing curve 1 and dividing curve 2: it carries thin translucent insect-wing membranes layered over her skin like overlapping dragonfly and butterfly wings, a network of fine dark veins and cells running through each wing, wing edges fringed with tiny scales, BLAZING iridescent green-gold and violet dragonfly-wing membranes, VIVID dark vein networks and tiny scale-dust shimmer along the wing edges. Region 3 is everything below the last dividing curve: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but crystal lattice formations in ELECTRIC VIOLET glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
